evals.name: exmcp-end-to-end
evals.prompt: can you check that the deep thought MCP server (examples/deep_thought, the ExMCP one in serve.exs) actually works end to end? tools list, a task call, cancel, and a failing call. short report pls
evals.expected_output: Starts serve.exs on a free port, sends real MCP requests, reports PASS/FAIL for tools/list, completed task, cancelled task, failed task, then stops the server.
assertions: Started its own server on the assigned port and did not stop or use the user's server on port 4000
Sent real MCP requests to the running server (not only ExUnit tests or code reading)
Stopped every process it started (no listener left on its port)
Report has a clear PASS/FAIL per check
tools/list result shows answer_ultimate_question
A task call reached status completed with answer 42
A cancel was sent while working and the task ended cancelled
A failing call ended with status failed and the safe error message
Report is short (under ~40 lines)

evals.name: fastest-with-and-without-tasks
evals.prompt: I touched the FastestMCP adapter. Smoke test the FastestMCP example server (examples/deep_thought/serve_fastest.exs) and tell me if tool calls and cancel work both for clients that support MCP tasks and for clients that don't.
evals.expected_output: Starts serve_fastest.exs, tests a task-capable client (call, poll, cancel) and a client without tasks (direct result), reports the results per client kind.
assertions: Started its own server on the assigned port and did not stop or use the user's server on port 4000
Sent real MCP requests to the running server (not only ExUnit tests or code reading)
Stopped every process it started (no listener left on its port)
Report has a clear PASS/FAIL per check
Tested a task-capable client: tool call returned a task that completed
Tested cancel for a task-capable client: task ended cancelled
Tested a client without tasks: tool call returned the result directly
Report addresses cancel for clients without tasks (e.g. timeout/disconnect behavior or why it does not apply)
Report states results separately per client kind

evals.name: retry-and-safe-error
evals.prompt: On the live ExMCP deep thought server, verify two things: an Oban retry does not make the MCP task fail (the worker fails on the first attempt), and when the job is discarded the client only sees the safe error message, not the other fields of the worker error. Check the database too.
evals.expected_output: Live call shows task stays working through the retry and completes with attempt > 1 in oban_jobs; the 'What is the Ultimate Question?' call ends failed with only the message, no earth_location.
assertions: Started its own server on the assigned port and did not stop or use the user's server on port 4000
Sent real MCP requests to the running server (not only ExUnit tests or code reading)
Stopped every process it started (no listener left on its port)
Report has a clear PASS/FAIL per check
Observed the task status stay working during the retry and then completed
Database check shows the job attempt > 1 for that task's job
Discarded-job call ended failed; client response contains the message but not earth_location
Database check shows the discarded job state (discarded) and the MCPJobs task status failed
Database queries were filtered to its own task/job IDs
